name: Sausage and Mash
description:
Two browned sausages rest on mashed roots under an onion gravy. The gravy is ladled over the plate just before it leaves the kitchen.

Sold as one individual supper portion. Price and weight cover the named food only; plates, bowls and cutlery remain with the inn. Drinks and unlisted sides are separate. This meal grants no automatic healing or resting bonus.
